data.name: Nawlah
data.gender_notes: Nawlah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawl', meaning 'to flow'. This name is often used to describe someone who is gentle, delicate, and graceful. In Islamic culture, it is said that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) had a daughter named Nawlah. The name Nawlah carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawlah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle and nurturing nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation.
data.etymology: Nawlah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawlah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

In Islamic literature and art, Nawlah can symbolize the delicate nature of life and relationships, reminding us to be gentle and compassionate in our actions towards others.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nawlah also holds a deeper spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is believed that the name reflects the flowing nature of God's mercy and grace. Just as a river flows gently and continuously, God's love and compassion never cease to flow towards us. This name reminds us to be mindful of God's presence in our lives and to strive towards living a life that reflects His mercy and compassion towards all of creation.
